summary: Docker host checks, app scaffolding, local app runs, installation, updates, and diagnostics.

commons.summary: Docker common helpers for CLI availability, daemon reachability, Compose, Buildx, host guidance, and daemon waiting.

dockerise.summary: Docker scaffold command implementation for target app directories.

run.summary: Docker local app build/run/open command implementation.

check.summary: Checks Docker CLI, daemon reachability, Compose v2 or legacy docker-compose, Buildx, runtime smoke via hello-world, and Docker disk usage.

options.--yes: Do not pause for the final acknowledgement prompt.
options.--verbose: Print docker info when the daemon is reachable.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

dockerise.summary: Scaffolds Docker deployment files for a target PHP/Apache or static/nginx app directory.

options.--type: Select scaffold type: auto, php-apache, or static-nginx.
options.--port: Set the generated container port. Defaults to 8080.
options.--force: Allow overwriting generated files that already exist.
options.--dry-run: Print planned file writes without writing files.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: Scaffold type cannot be detected and --type was not provided.
A generated file already exists and --force was not provided.

run.summary: Builds and runs a Dockerised app locally, maps it to localhost, and optionally opens the browser.

options.--container-port: Container port exposed by the app. Defaults to the first Dockerfile EXPOSE value, then 8080.
options.--image: Docker image tag. Defaults to blackhost-<target-dir-name>.
options.--name: Container name. Defaults to the image tag.
options.--no-build: Skip docker build and run the existing image tag.
options.--open: Open http://localhost:<port> after the container starts.
options.--dry-run: Print build, replace, run, and browser-open commands without executing them.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: Docker daemon is unavailable outside dry-run.
A matching container exists and replacement is declined.

install.summary: Installs Docker tooling with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected install command path without executing it, even if Docker is already installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.macos: Installs Docker Desktop through Homebrew cask, then optionally opens Docker Desktop.
supported_hosts.debian_like_linux: Installs Docker Engine, Docker CLI, containerd, Buildx plugin, and Compose plugin through Docker's apt repository.

update.summary: Updates Docker tooling with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected update command path without executing it, even if Docker is not installed.
options.--prune: Prompt to run docker system prune after update.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.macos: Updates Docker Desktop through Homebrew cask.
supported_hosts.debian_like_linux: Updates Docker Engine, Docker CLI, containerd, Buildx plugin, and Compose plugin through apt.

notes: check is non-mutating except for Docker's hello-world pull when Docker is reachable.
dockerise is host-read-only but may write Docker scaffold files inside the target workspace directory.
run may build images, replace same-name containers after confirmation, start a local container, and optionally open a browser.
run supports --dry-run where Docker and browser-open commands are printed but not executed.
install and update mutate the host and prompt unless --yes is provided.
install and update support --dry-run where detected host command paths are printed but not executed.
dry-run must not short-circuit just because Docker is already installed or currently missing.
update --prune may remove unused Docker objects after explicit confirmation.
